name: carry_chain_recognition_ripple_resynthesis
precondition: family dv_recon; Toffoli-level op list whose gates are only x / cx / cz / h / ccx / ccz / and_compute / and_uncompute / measure (no rz, no off-grid rotation), every cz or ccz reducible to cx/ccx by the h immediately before and after on its target wire, 10 <= qubits <= 34, ancilla_room available. Circuits with any gate outside this classical-reversible class are excluded and cost nothing.
identity: Recognize the whole op list as the in-place binary adder permutation |a>|b>|0...0> -> |a>|a+b mod 2^n>|0...0> (optionally with one carry-out wire holding bit n), then replace the ENTIRE circuit by Gidney's temporary-AND ripple-carry adder for the same wire assignment. Carry recurrence: c_0 = 0, c_{i+1} = a_i b_i XOR c_i (a_i XOR b_i) = MAJ(a_i, b_i, c_i), s_i = a_i XOR b_i XOR c_i. Per bit i, forward sweep: cx(a_i, b_i); cx(a_i, c_i); and_compute(b_i, c_i -> w_i) [4 T]; cx(w_i, a_i) so a_i now carries c_{i+1}; use a_i as the next carry wire. Backward sweep: for each i in reverse, and_uncompute(w_i) [0 T, measure w_i in the X basis and apply the classically controlled cz fix-up], then undo the linear wrapping with cx's and write s_i into b_i. The n-1 (or n) AND gadgets are the only non-Clifford content; the lookahead circuit's ~57 Toffolis, which recompute generate/propagate products across a logarithmic-depth tree, are discarded entirely.
correctness: The target is a permutation of computational basis states with no relative phase (every gate in the precondition class is a signed classical-reversible gate once cz/ccz are rewritten to cx/ccx by their flanking Hadamards, and and_compute/and_uncompute form an exact unitary pair on a clean ancilla). For n = 8 the data register is 16 bits, so the trigger CERTIFIES the permutation exhaustively: simulate all 2^16 assignments of (a, b) with all ancillas at 0 and require output = (a, a + b mod 2^n) (plus carry-out if a wire for it is identified) and every ancilla back at 0. Equality of two classical-reversible circuits on every basis state, with ancillas restored on every one of them, is equality of unitaries up to global phase - there is no phase freedom left to check because the class has none. Gidney's gadget is itself exact: and_compute(x,y->w) leaves w = xy, and the measurement-based uncompute is the identity on the data for both measurement branches once the classically controlled cz fix-up is applied, so invariant 2 (same c_m for every input, sum |c_m|^2 = 1) holds branch-wise. The carry recurrence above is the standard MAJ/UMA ripple-carry identity, verified bit by bit.
trigger: Fires at most once, on the whole op list. (1) All gates in the precondition class and every cz/ccz resolves to cx/ccx; else decline. (2) Partition the wires into candidate registers by the exhaustive classical simulation: find a pair of n-bit index tuples (A, B) and a set Z of ancilla wires such that for all 2^(2n) inputs the induced map is (a, b) -> (a, a+b mod 2^n) on (A, B) with Z restored to 0; search A, B over the natural adder layouts (wires that are never written vs. wires whose output bit depends on all lower a_j, b_j), not over all tuples. (3) If such (A, B, Z) exists, emit one match carrying the wire assignment; the apply step rebuilds the circuit from scratch as the ripple-carry cascade on those exact wires, allocating n-1 clean ancillas with append_ancillas if fewer than n-1 wires of Z are free. If no assignment validates, emit nothing.
expected_effect: All 54 and_compute gadgets, all 54 and_uncompute gadgets and the 57 cz / 67 cx of the lookahead tree are deleted and replaced by 7-8 and_compute / and_uncompute pairs plus ~40 cx and a few x gates. Non-Clifford cost goes from 54 x 4 T = 216 T to 8 x 4 T = 32 T (7 ANDs = 28 T if the top carry-out wire is not used, so the circuit is mod 2^8). This also lands well under pyzx's 173, which cannot reach it because full_reduce preserves the lookahead's Toffoli count structure and never trades depth for T. Qubit count stays at or below 25 (the lookahead's tree ancillas are freed; at most n-1 = 7 are needed live). CNOT count falls as well, so the lexicographic cost order improves on all three entries. Depth grows from O(log n) to O(n), which the cost order does not price.
source: Craig Gidney, 'Halving the cost of quantum addition', Quantum 2, 74 (2018) - temporary AND / measurement-based uncompute giving 4n T per n-bit addition; Cuccaro, Draper, Kutin, Moulton, 'A new quantum ripple-carry addition circuit', quant-ph/0410184 (the MAJ/UMA carry recurrence); contrast with Draper, Kutin, Rains, Svore, 'A logarithmic-depth quantum carry-lookahead adder', quant-ph/0406142, which is the structure the input implements.
